research_notes: Initial research1 October2026. Expanded sparse official business-owner entry using government2010review, historical employer/government reports, first speech, publisher credits, contemporary profiles and reporting.22 occupational/governance/activity records are not22 additive jobs.

Historical government review is especially useful for omitted SKM2009appointment, ABC cadetship and separate Indigenous media work. Raw PDF text has encoding problems, later open404 and direct public download403; use retrieved indexed biography with explicit limits. No access controls bypassed.

Voyages classification is grounded in2019–20Commonwealth budget: wholly owned ILSC subsidiary and public non-financial corporation. Executive title and published remuneration do not establish substantive full-time status; no years calculated.

IBA2016–17and2018–19PDFs could be opened but text find did not reliably expose board biographies. Do not assign adjacent directors' appointment dates from snippets. ILSC2018–19PDF403, ILSC2019–20open failed, Adelaide annual link redirected; Auditor-General indexed comparative report supplies council cessation. GPEx and Congress2016–17open failed; indexed employer tables retained with locators. Congress2015–16PDF400content too large36799603.

Public professional profile https://au.linkedin.com/in/kerrynne-liddle-9935bb1a7 returned999Unknown Status Code. No authenticated profile evidence used. Exact hours searches mainly found advertisements for her own staff, which are not evidence of her employment fraction.

Education BA/management, MBA and AICD/fellowship credentials are not employment. First speech confirms study while working but does not resolve hours or leave. Do not infer a1987career start from rounded23years in2010.

Follow up ABC/Seven/Imparja/CAAMA personnel histories, station employer for jillaroo work, business entities and operating periods, SKM/Santos transitions, Voyages contract/full-time status, Ruston staff appointment, and complete board terms/pay. Radio and writing may overlap consultancy; avoid duplicate totals.2019–22career coverage incomplete.

Senate interests search located Liddle Sapio Trust, but asset/trust declarations are not evidence of employment or active management. Other health/arts/tertiary roles and multiple businesses referenced generally in first speech remain unidentified; no completeness claim.
